settings.lede: Counter Culture Conflict is Murphy's take on the fights shaping the world: wars, unrest, policing and the politics behind them.
settings.text: Each episode takes the stories the big outlets smooth over, plays the footage, and says plainly what he thinks is going on. Global perspectives, unfiltered analysis.

settings.name: Counter Culture Inc
settings.tagline: A direct dose of truth and entertainment, counter to the narrative you have been fed.
settings.text: The independent network that produces Counter Culture Conflict and The Antihero Broadcast. No corporate owner and no script. Every show streams live on the network channel, and the replays stay up.

settings.name: The Antihero Broadcast
settings.tagline: Aggressive. Raw. Hilarious. In-your-face news and entertainment.
settings.text: The flagship show of the network: a live weekday broadcast that takes the day's news and argues it out on air, with the chat joining in.

settings.heading: The network
settings.text: Conflict is one show on an independent network. Here is who is behind it and where to watch.
